connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

enabled.title: cert-manager and CRDs
enabled.description: cert-manager, its CRDs and the trust-manager Bundle CRD. The first layer (00).

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Label the CRDs and controllers okdp.io/protected=true: the ValidatingAdmissionPolicy of the tools chart refuses to delete them.

enabled.title: trust-manager
enabled.description: Install trust-manager. Needs the cert-manager CRDs: a layer above the one installing cert-manager.

enabled.title: CA bundle
enabled.description: The Bundle of the issuers' CA certificates. Needs trust-manager running: a layer above trust.enabled.

enabled.title: Cluster issuers
enabled.description: Create the ClusterIssuers below. Needs the cert-manager CRDs: a layer above the one installing cert-manager.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

cert-manager.title: cert-manager
cert-manager.description: Values of the cert-manager chart v1.21.2 (https://charts.jetstack.io), rendered with certManager.enabled: image, resources, replicaCount, nodeSelector, tolerations, config, featureGates, webhook/cainjector settings, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, namespace, clusterResourceNamespace, installCRDs, crds, cainjector.enabled, disableAutoApproval, serviceAccount.create, webhook.serviceAccount.create, cainjector.serviceAccount.create, startupapicheck jobAnnotations, rbac.annotations and serviceAccount.annotations. Appended: webhook.extraArgs, approveSignerNames.

trust-manager.title: trust-manager
trust-manager.description: Values of the trust-manager chart v0.25.0 (https://charts.jetstack.io), rendered with trust.enabled (and for the Bundle CRD with certManager.enabled): image, resources, replicaCount, defaultPackage, app.logLevel, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, namespace, crds, app.trust.namespace, app.webhook.tls.helmCert, app.webhook.tls.approverPolicy, secretTargets, serviceAccount.create.

cert-issuers.title: cert-issuers
cert-issuers.description: Values of the cert-issuers chart 0.2.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/cert-issuers), rendered with issuers.enabled. Its templates read nothing besides the refused paths and global (security.podSecurityStandards is unused), so this is for later versions. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, caClusterIssuers, selfSignedClusterIssuers (set issuers.* instead), bundle (trust.bundle), replication.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
